title: What If You Could REWIND 60 Seconds?
description:
Glint, 19, works nights at the city science museum, oiling the gears of a 150-year-old tower clock. One stormy night, lightning strikes, every gear spins backwards, and he discovers he can rewind time by sixty seconds. But his brain can only carry four things back, chaos makes the same minute play out differently every time, and the minutes nobody else remembers start piling up in his head. Then his best friend Kai ends up hanging from the clock's minute hand, forty metres above the city, and Glint has one rewind left. The real science of reaction time, working memory, the butterfly effect and the pendulum decides how it ends.

Would you want this power, knowing every rewind leaves you remembering things nobody else ever will? Tell me in the comments 👇
